elements.content: Cover page artwork on a white background: the wordmark “VIỆT NAM” appears large in the lower-left/center area, with “VIỆT” in dark blue and “NAM” in a blue-to-orange gradient. Below it is the report title in bold blue uppercase: “BÁO CÁO QUỐC GIA / VỀ KHÍ HẬU VÀ PHÁT TRIỂN”. In the upper-right is an abstract circular topographic/contour-line graphic made of many concentric, irregular lines in light blue, blue, and some orange tones, suggesting a stylized landscape or climate motif. Main message: national climate and development report for Vietnam.
elements.notes: No chart/table/map with data values; this is a cover/branding illustration.
